Given the curve r(t)=8ti+cos⁡6tj+sin⁡6tk, t≥0, for which the arc length s from r(0) to r(t) is given by s=10t, find the corresponding unit tangent T(s), parametrized by s.

a
 T(s)=4s5i+35cos⁡(3s5)j+sin⁡(3s5)k
b
 T(s)=4s5i+cos⁡(3s5)j+sin⁡(3s5)k
c
 T(s)=35i+35sin⁡(3s5)j+35cos⁡(3s5)k
d
 T(s)=45i−35sin⁡(3s5)j+35cos⁡(3s5)k
e
 T(s)=2s5i+cos⁡(3s5)j+sin⁡(3s5)k
